feature_list.name: Clean child environment
feature_list.spec: Every child we start (PTY, external terminal, git, VS Code) gets the parent env minus ^(NO_COLOR|CLAUDECODE|CLAUDE_PID|CLAUDE_CODE_.+|GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT|CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)$ and minus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MODEL (audit). CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is then set per profile (unset for ~/.claude). Built in Rust env.rs::clean_env(), never by string concatenation.

feature_list.name: Resolve claude / shell / git / code executables
feature_list.spec: Resolved once at startup on a background thread and cached. Windows: walk PATH for claude.exe, then claude.cmd (never bare 'claude'; .cmd => args must match ^[A-Za-z0-9=_.:/-]+$). Shell: pwsh, else powershell.exe. macOS: run login+interactive shell from getpwuid pw_shell (fallback /bin/zsh) with 5 s timeout: `<shell> -ilc 'printf "__CM__%s__CM__%s__CM__" "$(command -v claude)" "$PATH"'`; cache PATH and claude path; fallback probe ~/.local/bin/claude, /opt/homebrew/bin/claude, /usr/local/bin/claude, ~/.claude/local/claude, ~/.npm-global/bin/claude, ~/.volta/bin/claude, ~/.bun/bin/claude. Optional user override settings.claudePath. Not found => in-app banner 'Claude Code was not found. Install it or set its path in Settings.' with link to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup; app keeps working.
feature_list.source_refs: ps1:36-38; audit macos blocker 'login shell skips zshrc'; research §5

feature_list.name: Settings persistence
feature_list.spec: Rust-owned JSON at app_config_dir()/settings.json (Windows %APPDATA%\com.ceylabs.claudemanager, macOS ~/Library/Application Support/com.ceylabs.claudemanager). First run imports legacy %APPDATA%\ClaudeManager\settings.json if present. Schema (all serde default, bad JSON -> defaults, unknown keys kept via flatten): pinned:string[], account:string|null, openIn:'external'|'embed' (default 'external'), showPicker:true, lastProfile:string|null ('all' or dir), groups:[{name,folders:string[],collapsed:bool}], ungroupedCollapsed:false, showUsage:true, notify:true, bgTerms:[] (kept, unused v1), plus new: sidebarWidth:340, gitSplit:null, claudePath:null, macOptionIsMeta:true, scrollback:5000, keepRunningOnClose:null. Atomic write (temp+rename), debounced 200 ms, emits 'settings-changed'.

feature_list.name: Session transcript parsing
feature_list.spec: Sessions = <profile>/projects/<slug>/<id>.jsonl (depth 1 only; ignore <id>/subagents). Skip files whose stem is not a UUID. Per line (strip BOM, trailing \r): user line = contains '"type":"user"' and not '"tool_result"' -> count++. cwd = first line containing '"cwd":"' (JSON top-level cwd). Prompt = first user line without '"isMeta":true': message.content string, or first array part type=='text'; skip empty or starting with '<'. customTitle: lines starting '{"type":"custom-title"', last wins; summary: first '{"type":"summary"'; aiTitle ('ai-title') as fallback after summary. full = title ?? summary ?? aiTitle ?? prompt ?? '(no prompt)'; whitespace collapsed; label 140 chars + '...', full 600 chars + '...'. count==0 sessions excluded. Fields: id, file, cwd, label, full, count, modified ms, sizeKb=ceil(len/1024), profile, slug. Lines > 8 MB only get cheap contains checks.

feature_list.name: Session index: cache, warm-up, watcher
feature_list.spec: Incremental per-file ParseState (offset after last \n, partial last line parsed into copy only), shrink -> reset; unchanged (len,mtime) -> no open. Persisted to app_cache_dir/sessions-cache.json (versioned). Cold scan: header pass (first 64 KB) then full count pass in background, largest files first with work-stealing. notify watcher per <profile>/projects (debounce 300 ms) re-parses only changed paths; emits 'index-changed' {gen}. No polling. Full rescan on F5 drops caches. Index changes bump a generation; frontend fetches only when gen changes.

feature_list.name: Live session detection
feature_list.spec: Every 2 s in Rust: (A) <profile>/sessions/<pid>.json {pid, sessionId, status, cwd, startedAt, procStart}: pid alive (sysinfo) and start time matches startedAt/procStart within 5 s (preferred over name allow-list; fallback names claude, node, pwsh, powershell, cmd, bash, zsh, sh, fish, or version-like names on mac); dead -> ignore (do not delete). level 2 if status=='busy' else 1. (B) <pid>.<hash>.key: pid alive, sorted by start time; session id from cmdline (--resume|-r|--session-id [ =]<uuid>) else newest jsonl modified since start-5 s not yet claimed; cwd = last '"cwd":"..."' in final 256 KB; level 2 if jsonl mtime < 8 s. Dedupe by sessionId preferring reachable (pid descends from our PTY child, or has a terminal ancestor), else higher level. Emit 'live-changed' only when signature 'id=level;...' changes. liveCwd map (key normalized).

Returns false if nothing.

Body '<label or cwd leaf or "Claude session">\n<cwd leaf>'. Disabled when notify=false. Suppressed if window focused and active tab owns that pid. Click -> show window + focus live session. None -> 'No background sessions to close\nEvery running session can be reached from a window.' Else warning 'Close N background session(s)?' listing up to 6 '  - <cwd leaf>  (pid N)'. architecture:
PRINCIPLE: every feature lives in its own Rust module folder and its own frontend feature folder. Shared files are touched only by one-line registrations in marked blocks. Cross-feature communication goes through typed contracts (Rust types exported with ts-rs, a typed frontend event bus, a typed store) and never by importing another feature's internals.

RUST (src-tauri/src/), single crate, edition 2024, panic=unwind:
- lib.rs: Builder only. Plugins (single-instance first, log, window-state, dialog, clipboard-manager, notification, opener [no webview permissions], updater, process). `.setup(|app| { core::init(app)?; <feature>::init(app)?; ... })` with one line per feature in a block `// ---- feature init (one line each) ----`. Uses `.build(ctx)?.run(lifecycle::on_run_event)`.
- commands.rs: the single `tauri::generate_handler![...]` macro, grouped by `// ---- <feature> ----` blocks. A package adds only lines in its own block.
- core/ (foundation, shared): error.rs (AppError via thiserror, Serialize as {code,message}; `type AppResult<T>`; lock helper that recovers poisoning), paths.rs (home, app_config/cache/data/log dirs, `norm(path)` trims / and \, `key(path)` lowercases on Windows and macOS, `is_within(child, root)`), env.rs (startup environment resolution: login-shell PATH on mac, claude/shell/git/code path discovery, `clean_env(&mut CommandBuilder|Command)`, `platform_info()` {os, build, arch}), procs.rs (sysinfo wrapper refreshed on demand: alive, name, start_time, cmdline, parent chain, descendants_of, kill_tree(pid) using Job Object/taskkill /T on Windows and killpg SIGHUP->SIGTERM->SIGKILL on Unix), spawn.rs (`hidden_command(program)` std Command with CREATE_NO_WINDOW + cleaned env + cached PATH), profiles.rs (discovery, name, email, `resolve_profile(dir) -> AppResult<PathBuf>` that only accepts a discovered profile), settings.rs (Settings struct, load/import/atomic save, get_settings/update_settings commands, 'settings-changed' event), lifecycle.rs (CloseRequested/ExitRequested/Reopen/Exit handling; emits 'app:close-requested' {terminals:n} to frontend and exposes command `app_quit_decision(decision)`; Exit -> calls registered shutdown hooks), events.rs (event name constants), types.rs (shared ts-rs types: Profile, Session, Project, LiveSession, TermInfo, Settings).
- Feature modules (each a folder with mod.rs exposing `pub fn init(app:&mut App)->AppResult<()>` that does `app.manage(...)`, spawns its background threads, and #[tauri::command] fns): sessions/ (WP1), pty/ + launch/ (WP2), live/ + notify/ (WP3), sidebar has no Rust except fs helpers in sessions (WP4 uses trash command from WP5), actions/ (WP5: trash, reveal, copy), profiles_ui commands in core/profiles (WP6 adds create_profile in profiles_cmd.rs), usage/ (WP7), git/ (WP8), os/ (WP9: tray, menu, explorer_menu, vscode, focus_window), updater handled in frontend + plugin line (WP10).
- Types: every IPC struct derives Serialize + ts_rs::TS with #[ts(export, export_to = "../../src/bindings/")]; `cargo test` exports; CI fails if src/bindings changes after tests. Commands are async (or spawn_blocking) unless trivial; nothing blocking runs on the main thread.
- Security rules: webview never passes executable args, env, or arbitrary paths to run. Commands take ids (session id UUID, profile dir validated by resolve_profile, project dir validated is_dir). Paths for delete/trash must be inside a profile dir. Token never leaves Rust.

FRONTEND (src/), vanilla TS, no framework; lit-html allowed for keyed rendering (`repeat`):
- main.ts (~40 lines): imports styles/tokens.css + base.css, core bootstrap, then `src/features/index.ts` which has one `mount()` call per feature (one line each in a marked block).
- core/: store.ts (`createStore<AppState>`, get/set/select/subscribe; AppState is an interface each feature extends by TS declaration merging in its own file `features/x/state.ts`), bus.ts (typed emit/on; `interface AppEvents` extended by declaration merging per feature), api.ts (`call<T>(cmd,args)` wrapper: logs, toasts errors, returns Result-like; `listen` wrapper), settings.ts (typed settings mirror + `updateSettings(patch)`), platform.ts (isMac/isWindows from platform_info command; mod key labels), keyboard.ts (shortcut registry `registerShortcut({id, keys:'CmdOrCtrl+F', when, run})`, native 'menu' events routed to same ids), commands.ts (named actions registry used by menus, shortcuts, native menu), format.ts (ago, size, fmtTokens, until, resetText, truncate), dom.ts (esc, html tag, keyed list helpers), motion.ts (Spring/animate/smoothScroll from spring.ts; reduced motion; no wheel hijack on mac), icons.ts (inline SVG set incl. folder, star, warning, group, chevrons, plus, close, home, terminal, branch, fetch, pull, push, refresh, check, trash, vscode, popout, search), i18n per feature (`features/x/strings.ts`).
- ui/ (foundation, shared kit): button.ts, segmented.ts, toggle.ts, splitbutton.ts, texttabs.ts, avatar.ts, tooltip.ts, menu.ts (ContextMenu), popover.ts, dialog.ts (ask/message/input), list.ts (virtual keyed list + selection model + keyboard + aria), splitter.ts, toast.ts, each with its css in ui/*.css.
- Layout shell (index.html, foundation-owned) with fixed slots: #titlebar [#tb-lights (Windows only), #tb-title, #tb-search-slot, #tb-right-slot], #picker-root, #main [#tabstrip-slot, #workspace [#sidebar-slot | splitter | #card [#card-head (segmented view switch + #card-actions-slot) , #card-body]] , #terminal-root], #overlay-root (menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts). Views registry (core/views.ts): `registerView({id:'sessions'|'git', title, mount(body), headerActions(el), onShow, onHide})`; foundation renders the segmented switch from the registered views.
- Core AppState (foundation defines): profiles: Profile[]; currentProfile: string|null ('all'=null); screen: 'picker'|'main'; settings: Settings; index: {gen, projects: Project[], loaded:'loading'|'ok'|'empty'|'error'}; live: Record<sessionId, LiveSession> + liveCwd: Record<key, 1|2>; sidebarSelection: {kind:'folder'|'group', key, path?, name?, folders?}|null; terminals: TermInfo[] {id, ptyId, pid, title, sub, dir, profile, sessionId?}; activeTerminal: id|null; view: 'sessions'|'git'.
- Core bus events (foundation defines contract; implementers listed): 'launch' {dir, profile?, mode?:'embed'|'external', resume?:{sessionId, fork?}, label?} -> WP2; 'terminal:show' {id|null} -> WP2; 'session:resume' {sessionId, mode?, fork?} -> WP5 (does focus-live check then 'launch'); 'live:focus' {sessionId} -> WP3 returns via promise helper `focusLive(id): Promise<boolean>` exported from features/live/api.ts (allowed import: features may import another feature's public `api.ts` only); 'refresh:full' -> WP1 frontend adapter; 'sidebar:select' {key}; 'search:focus'; 'profile:enter' {dir|null} -> WP6; 'profile:new' -> WP6; 'picker:show' -> WP6.
- Styling: styles/tokens.css holds all palette tokens (light/dark + fixed colors), styles/base.css resets (user-select with -webkit- prefix, focus-visible ring, appearance:none on controls, scrollbar styles). Each feature imports its own css; class names prefixed by feature (`sb-`, `ses-`, `term-`, `git-`, `use-`, `prof-`).
- Tests: Rust #[cfg(test)] + src-tauri/tests/fixtures; frontend vitest + happy-dom, `*.test.ts` next to code. Lint: biome; rustfmt (max_width 120); clippy -D warnings.

work_packages.title: Session index engine (Rust) + data adapter
work_packages.scope:
Make session data fast, correct and event-driven. Rust in src-tauri/src/sessions/: parse.rs, scan.rs, cache.rs, watch.rs, group.rs, mod.rs.
1) Parsing parity (see feature 'Session transcript parsing'): files <profile>/projects/<slug>/<id>.jsonl depth 1 only; skip non-UUID stems (^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$); skip symlinks; strip BOM and \r; user line = contains '"type":"user"' and not '"tool_result"' (check only first 4 KB of line for type/tool_result); cwd first '"cwd":"' (top-level JSON); prompt first non-isMeta user line, message.content string or first {type:'text'} part, skip empty or leading '<'; customTitle last wins; summary first; ai-title (aiTitle) fallback after summary; full = title??summary??aiTitle??prompt??'(no prompt)', whitespace collapsed, label 140+'...', full 600+'...'. Store truncated prompt/title (<=600 chars) in state. count==0 excluded. Session fields: id, file, cwd, label, full, count, modified(ms), sizeKb=ceil(len/1024), profile, slug.
2) Scanner struct (no globals): `Scanner::new(cache_path)`; `scan(profiles:&[PathBuf])`; ParseState per path {len, mtimeMs, offset, cwd, prompt, title, summary, aiTitle, count}; unchanged len+mtime -> no open; len<offset -> reset; read from offset with memchr newline search, thread_local 256 KB buffer, memmem finders; partial trailing line parsed into a copy only; lines >8 MB skipped except cheap checks. Prune states for unseen paths. Persist to app_cache_dir/sessions-cache.json {version:1, entries} after scans that changed something (atomic write).
3) Two-phase cold scan: phase A reads first 64 KB of uncached files (cwd, prompt, title) and returns with count=null... simpler: count from partial bytes flagged `partial:true`; phase B full read with rayon par_iter sorted largest first; emit 'index-changed' {gen} when done.
4) Index state managed: HashMap<path, Session>, gen counter (bumps on change). Watcher (notify-debouncer-full, 300 ms) on every profile's projects dir (re-subscribe on 'profiles-changed'); only changed .jsonl paths re-parsed; deleted removed. Commands: get_index(since_gen:Option<u64>) -> {gen, projects:Option<Vec<Project>>, profiles counts} (projects None if unchanged); rescan_full() (drops caches); count_for(profile). Group (group.rs, pure, unit-tested): key = paths::key(norm(cwd)) else slug; sessions without cwd -> project 'Unknown folder' keyed by slug; pinned (from settings, re-group on 'settings-changed') adds empty entries with pinned=true; missing = !is_dir; sessions newest first; projects pinned first then modified desc. Project {path, name(leaf or full path), modified, pinned, missing, sessions}. Payload slim: drop file? keep file (needed for reveal) but omit per-session cwd when equal to project path.
5) Frontend adapter features/index-data/: on start and on 'index-changed' call get_index(since gen) with in-flight guard (one in flight, rerun once if another event came) and sequence check; writes store.index {gen, projects, loaded}; 'loaded' = 'empty' when no profiles/sessions with message 'No Claude Code sessions found in ~/.claude*', 'error' with Retry. Handles 'refresh:full' -> rescan_full. Removes the 15 s polling and focus refresh. Expose helpers in features/index-data/api.ts: projectsFor(profile|null), findSession(id), countFor(profile).
Audit items: first-scan persisted cache, two-phase scan, memchr, work stealing, no-open when unchanged, STATES pruning/unbounded growth, unbounded line + symlinks, overlapping refresh, polling, payload size, scanner testability, resume id as flag (UUID filter), APFS case key, silent load errors (state), grouping of cwd-less sessions.

Before tagging v1.0.0:
1. Identifier frozen (com.ceylabs.claudemanager or the owner's final choice) and legacy %APPDATA%\ClaudeManager\settings.json import tested on a machine that used the PowerShell app.
2. CI green on windows-latest and macos-latest: biome, tsc, vitest, cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test, bindings up to date.
3. Every audit blocker/high verified closed (map: WP1 cache/scanner; WP2 PTY security, exit detection, kill tree, async commands, Cmd+Q, Ctrl+C/V, Option meta; WP7 keychain; WP9 native menu; WP10 icons, signing, updater, CI release; Foundation CSP, settings, logging, login-shell PATH, title bar, tests, types, restructure, focus/keyboard).
4. Manual parity pass on Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS 14 and 15 (Apple Silicon + Intel) using the feature list v1 items: picker, profiles (incl. a second signed-in profile on mac via Keychain), sidebar groups/pins/drag, sessions table/details/delete to Trash/Recycle Bin, search, terminals (new/resume/fork/close/pop-out/keep running/quit), external window mode, live dots + notifications + focus live, orphans, usage ring/popover, source control full flow, Explorer menu (Win), VS Code/reveal/copy, F5/Cmd+R, file drops.
5. Finder-launched mac app finds claude from ~/.local/bin, Homebrew and nvm installs; Windows finds claude.exe and npm claude.cmd.
6. Process hygiene: after closing tabs, quitting and crashing (kill the app) no claude/node/MCP processes remain (Job Object on Windows; killpg on mac).
7. Performance: warm start to sidebar < 300 ms with 300 MB of transcripts; idle CPU ~0 (no polling); 10 busy tabs stay responsive; memory flat over a 2-hour session.
8. Accessibility: keyboard-only navigation of sidebar, table, tabs, menus, dialogs; visible focus rings; contrast AA for text on accent and muted.
9. Security: CSP active (check devtools for violations), no opener permissions in webview, pty commands accept only validated ids, OSC 8/file:// links blocked, token never in logs or IPC (grep logs).
10. Signing: Windows Authenticode (or documented unsigned), macOS Developer ID + notarized + stapled; spctl -a -vv passes.
11. Updater: latest.json published, update from previous version tested on both OSes; signing private key backed up in two places.
12. Logs written to app_log_dir with rotation; 'Show logs' works; panic produces a log entry.
13. README, LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, CHANGELOG updated; version single source matches tag; draft release reviewed then published.
risks:
1. macOS Keychain naming for non-default profiles (sha256 prefix of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) is unconfirmed and Anthropic may tighten Keychain ACLs; reads could prompt or fail. Mitigation: hashed -> plain -> file fallback, never block UI, show 'Not signed in' with a hint; verify on a real Mac early in WP7.
2. Undocumented usage endpoint (api/oauth/usage) may change shape or rate-limit persistently. Mitigation: tolerant parsing, legacy fallback, cache, backoff; usage is non-critical.
3. Claude Code internal files (sessions/<pid>.json, .key files, transcript record types) can change between versions. Mitigation: start-time based validation, ignore unknown fields, fixtures from current versions, logging of parse misses; live detection degrades gracefully to 'not live'.
4. Notification click handling in tauri-plugin-notification is limited on desktop; click-to-focus-session may need platform code (Windows toast activation / UNUserNotificationCenter delegate). Mitigation: fallback 'focus on activation within 10 s'.
5. 'Keep running in background' across real app restarts is not provided in v1 (process stays alive hidden instead); a crash or reboot ends sessions (they remain resumable). Documented; sidecar daemon is 'later'.
6. Pop-out windows re-attaching a PTY channel and ring-buffer replay may render imperfectly for full-screen TUIs; mitigation: send a resize to force Claude to repaint after attach.
7. Parallel work collisions on shared files (commands.rs, lib.rs, features/index.ts, core types). Mitigation: marked per-feature blocks, append-only rule, types changed only by adding fields, foundation defines all core contracts first; stubs for cross-package APIs.
8. Bundle identifier change after foundation orphans data; must be confirmed by the owner before F2 lands.
9. Code-signing certificates (Apple Developer ID, Azure Trusted Signing) are external procurement with lead time; unsigned macOS builds are effectively blocked on macOS 15.
10. ConPTY differences on Windows 10 (pre-24H2 ClosePseudoConsole hang, reflow) — mitigated by drain-until-EOF and dropping master off-thread, real build number for xterm.
11. Login-shell environment probe on mac can hang or print noise from rc files (oh-my-zsh, prompts). Mitigation: markers, 5 s timeout, interactive flag only in the probe, fallbacks to known paths and settings.claudePath.
12. WebView2 HTML5 drag-and-drop conflicts with Tauri dragDropEnabled; internal drags use pointer events only.
13. Users running the old PowerShell app at the same time: separate settings files after import means changes do not sync back; documented in README.
